name: Velea Serviced Apartments & Suites
description:
Velea Serviced Apartments & Suites are designed for guests seeking space, comfort, and flexibility in the heart of Siem Reap. Combining the independence of premium apartment living with professional, hotel-style support, Velea is suited to both short visits and longer stays.

The property features fully furnished studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, each with private balconies and thoughtful layouts designed for work, relaxation, and everyday living. Guests benefit from 24/7 reception and security, ensuring a smooth and well-supported stay while maintaining privacy and independence.

Set within the Rose Apple Square lifestyle precinct, Velea offers access to a swimming pool, fitness center, and Siem Reap House — the city’s largest and leading co-working space and meeting facility. On-site amenities including Kaifun Café Eatery, kid's playground, park, a convenience store, and a boutique gift store create an easy, walkable environment throughout your stay.

Ideally positioned just minutes from Pub Street and within easy reach of Angkor Wat and the surrounding region, Velea Serviced Apartments & Suites provides a calm, contemporary base for exploring Siem Reap while enjoying the comfort and liveability of a professionally managed serviced apartment.

name: Baahu Villa
description:
Baahu Villa- Siem Reap features parking garage for guests, a bar and shared lounge in Siem Reap. With free WiFi, this 3-star hotel has a garden and a terrace. The accommodation provides a 24-hour front desk, a concierge service and currency exchange for guests.

The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms offering a desk, a kettle, a fridge, a minibar, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a shower. At Baahu Villa- Siem Reap each room is equipped with bed linen and towels.

We have contributed in a joint effort to reduce the single use plastic through offering the refillable container for most of hotel's amenities such as shampoo, shower gel, hand wash. Also, we avoid using the plastic and single use bottle of water provided in each room by replacing with the refillable glass bottles of water.

Baahu Villa- Siem Reap set herself as part of contribution to underprivileged personnel aim to grow skill and experience in Hotel industry through job opportunities and training.

Popular points of interest near the hotel include Pub Street, Old market, Pub-street and Major Cineplex Siem Reap. The nearest airport is Siem Reap Angkor International Airport (SAI), 50 km from Baahu Villa- Siem Reap.

name: Kouprey Hotel
description:
Built in November 2014, Kouprey Hotel is a boutique hotel located in Siem Reap, Cambodia, the Kingdom of Wonder.

At Kouprey Hotel we aim to make your stay in Siem Reap as enjoyable as possible by providing the highest level of service, spotlessly clean rooms and a safe environment.

Kouprey provides the ultimate location for family, adventure and leisure travellers alike. We cater for a wide variety of needs and understand that each visitor is unique in how they experience the wonders of Siem Reap. We want all our guests to leave with good memories and feel embraced by the warm hospitality of Siem Reap.

Kouprey Hotel is Cambodian owned and operated by local people who have inherent knowledge about Siem Reap and who abide by ethical and conservation principles to ensure benefits from the hotel are used to promote and preserve the cultural and natural heritage of Cambodia.

This is very important to allow Cambodia to move forward from its recent traumatic past of the Pol Pot Period. Everyone has been affected and each of our staff has a story of what happened to them and their family. At the same time as the people suffered, the environment and many of our natural wildlife species, were also decimated, including Cambodia's national animal, the Kouprey. This beautiful majestic animal with its long and wide-reaching horns has now become the country's symbol of the perilous situation for Cambodia's natural heritage. Thus the hotel has aptly chosen the Kouprey as its name to symbolize our vision to support Cambodia in creating ethical and environmentally sustainable solutions to secure our future.

name: Empress Angkor Resort & Spa
description:
Located across the Angkor Eye around 1640 ft, Empress Angkor Hotel has an pool and a spa. Free WiFi is available throughout the property.

Featuring wooden flooring and furnishings, the air-conditioned rooms at Empress Angkor have a flat-screen cable TV, mini-bar and personal safe. Some rooms have a separate living area. The private bathrooms are fitted with a bathtub and hot shower.

Guests can exercise in the fitness center, or relax in the sauna. The Hotel provide convenience of a 24-hour reception and a tour desk. Free parking is provided on site.

name: Apsara Greenland Boutique Hotel
description:
Apsara Greenland is well-designed for a relaxing and peaceful place with green nature. The Hotel features all spacious rooms, suites and villas with private terrace/ balcony, and is located close to the city of town and in the middle of local cultivated village, Sala Kamroeuk commune.

Designed with clear vision for the property emphasized the essential need for a luxury modern style and colonial in Siem Reap - one that both inspired and excited the modern millennial traveler. Apsara Greenland which blends the traditional elements of design with contemporary with intimate yet inviting, vibrant yet tranquil. The name is inspired mixture of Apsara at temples in Angkor ruins and greatness reputation and that are base in Siem Reap which struggling came across the last period of Angkor Empire. Apsara Greenland is about an easy, timeless elegance that fuses a taste for modern conveniences and technology with deference to culture and heritage.
